[1] faq.md > Is shipping free?
### How long will my order take to arrive?

Orders placed before 2:00 PM Eastern on a business day leave our Hagerstown warehouse the same
day. Standard shipping takes 3 to 6 business days by UPS Ground or USPS. Expedited shipping takes
2 business days and overnight shipping arrives the next business day if you order by 1:00 PM
Eastern.

### Is shipping free?

Standard shipping is free on orders of $75 or more. Below that, standard shipping is a flat $6.95.
Expedited shipping is $14.95 and overnight is $29.95 on any order size.

### Do you ship outside the United States?

We ship to all 50 states and to Canada. Shipping to Canada is a flat $19.95 and takes 5 to 10
business days; duties and taxes are paid by the recipient on delivery. We do not ship to any
other country.

[2] release-notes.md > Changes
### Highlights

Free standard shipping now starts at $60, down from $75. The threshold is applied to the order
subtotal before shipping and tax, the same way the $75 threshold was. The shipping page and the
cart both show the new amount, and the cart shows how much more a customer needs to add to
qualify. We expect the change to move a good share of the $60–$75 orders that used to stall at
the cart.

Gift cards are on sale for the first time. They come in $25, $50, $100 and $200 amounts, are
delivered by email within an hour of purchase, and can be redeemed online or at either
showroom. Gift cards are final sale and do not earn Lumen Rewards points when bought, though
purchases paid with them do.

Lumen Rewards points now appear at checkout. A member sees the points the order will earn next
to the order total, and any reward they have available is offered as a payment line before the
card step.

### Changes

- Free shipping threshold: $60 (was $75). The old threshold was in place since the store
  launched; this is the first change to it.
- Gift card purchase, delivery and redemption, online and in-store.
- Points preview and reward redemption at checkout for signed-in Lumen Rewards members.
- The order confirmation email now lists the delivery estimate as a date range rather than
  "3–6 business days".
- Signature-required orders (over $400) now say so on the checkout page, not only in the
  confirmation email.

### Fixes

- The Canada shipping option no longer appears for carts that contain fuel. Fuel does not ship
  to Canada and the cart said so only at the final step.
- Saved addresses with an apartment number were losing the apartment line when edited.
- The compare page listed the Sentinel 1000 Pro's weight as 1.4 kg; it is 1.9 kg.

[3] shipping.md > Rates and delivery times
## Rates and delivery times

All orders ship from the warehouse at 1180 Downsville Pike, Hagerstown, MD 21740. Delivery times
are in business days (Monday to Friday, excluding the six company holidays) and count from the
day the order leaves the warehouse, not the day it was placed.

| Service   | Cost                             | Delivery time         | Same-day cutoff |
|-----------|----------------------------------|-----------------------|-----------------|
| Standard  | $6.95, free on orders of $75 or more | 3 to 6 business days | 2:00 PM ET    |
| Expedited | $14.95                           | 2 business days       | 2:00 PM ET      |
| Overnight | $29.95                           | Next business day     | 1:00 PM ET      |
| Canada    | $19.95 flat                      | 5 to 10 business days | 2:00 PM ET      |

| Service   | Cost                             | Delivery time         | Same-day cutoff |
|-----------|----------------------------------|-----------------------|-----------------|
| Standard  | $6.95, free on orders of $75 or more | 3 to 6 business days | 2:00 PM ET    |
| Expedited | $14.95                           | 2 business days       | 2:00 PM ET      |
| Overnight | $29.95                           | Next business day     | 1:00 PM ET      |
| Canada    | $19.95 flat                      | 5 to 10 business days | 2:00 PM ET      |

Standard shipping is free on orders with a merchandise subtotal of $75 or more, calculated after
discounts and before tax. Fuel and oversized items count toward the subtotal. Orders under $75
pay the flat $6.95. Expedited and overnight are never free, though Flame and Beacon tier Lumen
Rewards members receive free upgrades from standard to expedited under the terms of that program.

Overnight service is available only to addresses in the contiguous 48 states and only for orders
placed by 1:00 PM ET on a business day. An overnight order placed on a Friday before the cutoff is
delivered on Monday.

## Dispatch

Orders placed before 2:00 PM ET on a business day ship the same day. Orders placed after 2:00 PM
ET, on a weekend or on a holiday ship the next business day. The warehouse runs two pick waves, at
10:30 AM and 2:15 PM; the afternoon wave is the one that catches orders placed just before the
cutoff. Carriers collect at 4:30 PM.

Every order gets a tracking number by email when the label is printed. If the email has not
arrived by the next morning the order is almost always still in the warehouse; agents should check
the order status in Hearth before offering anything to the customer.

Orders that contain a backordered item are held until the whole order can ship, unless the
customer asks for a split shipment. A split shipment costs the customer nothing; the warehouse
absorbs the second label.

[4] shipping.md > Signature on delivery
### Canada

Canadian orders cost a flat $19.95 and take 5 to 10 business days. Duties, GST/HST and any
brokerage fee are paid by the recipient on delivery; the company does not collect them and cannot
estimate them. Fuel does not ship to Canada. Shipping to Canada was added with Hearth 4.2 on
August 11, 2026; before that, Canadian customers ordered by phone and paid actual carrier cost.

### Signature on delivery

Orders over $400 ship with a signature required. The threshold is applied to the merchandise
subtotal. Customers who cannot be present may redirect the package to a UPS Access Point through
the carrier's tracking page. The warehouse does not waive the signature requirement on request.

## Fuel and hazardous materials

Clearburn White Gas (LS-FUEL1), Clearburn Lamp Oil (LS-OIL1) and kerosene are limited-quantity
hazardous materials, shipped as ORM-D. The rules are:

- Fuel ships by ground only. It cannot go expedited or overnight; an order containing fuel is
  downgraded to standard shipping and the customer is told at checkout.
- Fuel does not ship to PO boxes.
- Fuel does not ship to Alaska, Hawaii or Canada.
- No more than 8 quarts of fuel ship in one package. Larger fuel orders are split.
- Fuel ships only in its original sealed container, in the warehouse's partitioned fuel cartons.

An order that mixes fuel with other items ships as two packages when the non-fuel items are
eligible for a faster service the customer has paid for. Otherwise the whole order ships ground.

Fuel-burning lanterns that have never had fuel in them are ordinary goods and ship by any
service. A fueled lantern, for example one coming back for repair, must be fully drained and
aired out before it ships; the Repair Center's instructions cover this.

[5] customer-service-playbook.md > Goodwill and approvals
## Repairs

Any repair, under warranty or paid, gets a repair ticket in the form RT-xxxxx (five digits), for
example RT-20931. Create it in the Hearth admin from the warranty claim or from scratch for a paid
repair. The ticket number goes on the box and in the email to the customer.

Customers can drop a lantern off at either showroom or mail it to Lantern Supply Co. Repair
Center, 1180 Downsville Pike, Dock B, Hagerstown, MD 21740. Annapolis drop-offs are shipped to
Hagerstown weekly on Tuesdays, so tell Annapolis customers to add a week. Walt Brannigan, Head
of Repairs, emails a quote for paid repairs before any work is done; nothing is charged until the
customer approves the quote. Fuel lanterns must be emptied before they are mailed; tell the
customer, and put it in the email.

## Goodwill and approvals

You may give a goodwill credit of up to $25 per incident without approval: a discount code, a
free mantle pack, a refunded shipping charge. Log it on the ticket with a one-line reason.

Above $25, ask the shift lead. The Three Lights rule covers larger amounts: any refund, credit or
goodwill over $500 needs the approval of Tomas Reyes, and anything over $2,000 needs the approval
of Priya Whitcomb-Nair. "Any" means any: a refund that is simply the price of a returned Sentinel
1000 Pro and a Northstar together is over $500 and needs Tomas's sign-off before it is released,
even though the policy clearly allows it. Approvals are recorded on the ticket as a note from the
approver, not as a verbal okay.

## Escalation path

Agent, then shift lead, then Tomas Reyes. Escalate when a customer asks for a manager twice, when
a decision needs an approval you cannot give, when a customer mentions a lawyer, a regulator or
the press, or when you are not sure. Hand the ticket over with a two-line summary at the top: what
happened, what the customer wants. Do not promise a callback time for someone else; say that the
shift lead will be in touch by the end of the next business day.

Safety reports, meaning any claim that a product caught fire, leaked fuel, overheated or injured
someone, go to Tomas Reyes and Walt Brannigan the same day, whatever the amount, and the product is
recalled to Hagerstown for inspection at our expense.
